segments.text: Chromatography. The purification of chemicals is one of the most important
segments.zh: 色谱。化学品的纯化是研究型化学工作者最重要的

segments.text: jobs of a research chemist. Perhaps the most common purification technique in
segments.zh: 工作之一。在有机实验室中，最常用的纯化技术

segments.text: an organic laboratory is column chromatography. This technique takes
segments.zh: 也许就是柱色谱。这种技术利用

segments.text: advantage of the different polarities of different compounds to separate mixtures
segments.zh: 不同化合物极性的差异来分离混合物，

segments.text: frequently on the gram scale. Technically, column chromatography can be
segments.zh: 规模常常在克级。从技术上讲，柱色谱可能

segments.text: challenging, but with a little practice you will be able to separate mixtures
segments.zh: 有一定难度，但只要稍加练习，你就能稳定而成功地分离

segments.text: of compounds consistently and successfully. As the name suggests, a
segments.zh: 化合物混合物。顾名思义，

segments.text: column of adsorbent, either silica or alumina, is packed into a glass tube with
segments.zh: 就是把一柱吸附剂（硅胶或氧化铝）装填在一根

segments.text: a stopcock at the bottom. The sample is applied to the top of the adsorbent and
segments.zh: 底部带活塞的玻璃管中。样品加在吸附剂顶部，

segments.text: solvent is run through the column until the compound is flushed out of the
segments.zh: 然后让溶剂流过色谱柱，直到化合物从柱子

segments.text: bottom. In most cases, flash column chromatography is used, meaning that
segments.zh: 底部被冲洗出来。大多数情况下使用的是快速柱色谱（flash），也就是

segments.text: pressure is applied to the top of the column resulting in faster running times
segments.zh: 在柱子顶部加压，从而使运行时间更短、

segments.text: and better separation. Before you can run a column, you need to decide on the
segments.zh: 分离效果更好。在跑柱子之前，你需要确定

segments.text: appropriate conditions. It is vital that you pick a solvent system that will
segments.zh: 合适的条件。至关重要的是，要选一个能

segments.text: provide good separation. In general, you will use a mixture of two miscible
segments.zh: 提供良好分离的溶剂体系。一般来说，你会使用两种可互溶

segments.text: solvents, one polar and one nonpolar. Luckily, TLC is an effective tool for
segments.zh: 溶剂的混合物，一种是极性的，一种是非极性的。幸运的是，TLC 是一个有效的工具，

segments.text: deciding on the optimal solvent system for your sample. Make a TLC sample by
segments.zh: 可以用来确定适合你样品的最佳溶剂体系。制备 TLC 样品时，

segments.text: dissolving a small amount of your material in approximately one milliliter
segments.zh: 把少量物料溶解在约 1 毫升

segments.text: of solvent. Use this sample to spot several TLC plates and develop each
segments.zh: 溶剂中。用这个样品点几块 TLC 板，每块板

segments.text: plate in a different solvent system. Make sure that the adsorbent on your
segments.zh: 用不同的溶剂体系展开。确保你

segments.text: TLC plates is the same as the adsorbent you will use in the column,
segments.zh: TLC 板上的吸附剂与柱子中要用的吸附剂相同，

segments.text: either silica or alumina. Most commonly, you will use a solvent system
segments.zh: 都是硅胶或都是氧化铝。最常用的溶剂体系

segments.text: composed of a mixture of epoacetate and hexane. But when you are purifying
segments.zh: 是乙酸乙酯和己烷的混合物。但当你纯化

segments.text: a volatile compound, it is a good idea to use a lower boiling solvent system,
segments.zh: 易挥发的化合物时，最好使用沸点较低的溶剂体系，

segments.text: such as a mixture of ether and pentane. Mixtures of methanol and dichloromethane
segments.zh: 比如乙醚和戊烷的混合物。甲醇和二氯甲烷的混合物

segments.text: are frequently used to purify highly polar compounds. When you are removing
segments.zh: 常用于纯化极性很大的化合物。当你要从样品中除去

segments.text: small amounts of impurities from a sample, focus on the major constituent.
segments.zh: 少量杂质时，要着眼于主要成分。

segments.text: Once you have found a solvent system that separates the components of your sample,
segments.zh: 一旦找到了能分开样品各组分的溶剂体系，

segments.text: adjust the polarity so that the major, and hopefully the desired constituent,
segments.zh: 就调节极性，使主要成分（但愿也是目标成分）

segments.text: has an RF of approximately 0.3. If the RF is too low, then the solvent system is too
segments.zh: 的 Rf 值约为 0.3。如果 Rf 太低，说明溶剂体系

segments.text: nonpolar, and it will take a very long time for the material to come off of the column.
segments.zh: 极性太小，物料要很长时间才能从柱子上下来。

segments.text: Alternatively, if the RF is too high, then the solvent system is too polar,
segments.zh: 反之，如果 Rf 太高，说明溶剂体系极性太大，

segments.text: and the material will come off of the column very quickly with poor separation.
segments.zh: 物料会很快从柱子上下来，分离效果很差。

segments.text: When you are separating a mixture of two or more compounds, adjust the solvent polarity,
segments.zh: 当你分离两种或多种化合物的混合物时，要调节溶剂极性，

segments.text: such that the midpoint between the spots is at an RF of approximately 0.3.
segments.zh: 使斑点之间的中点 Rf 值约为 0.3。

segments.text: When you are separating two or more compounds with very different polarity,
segments.zh: 当你分离两种或多种极性相差很大的化合物时，

segments.text: it will save you time to increase the polarity of the solvent as the column proceeds.
segments.zh: 随着过柱的进行逐步增大溶剂极性，可以为你节省时间。

segments.text: Begin the column with a solvent system that puts the least polar compound
segments.zh: 开始过柱时，先用一个使极性最小的化合物

segments.text: at an RF of approximately 0.3. Once that compound has completely come off of the column,
segments.zh: Rf 值约为 0.3 的溶剂体系。等该化合物完全从柱子上下来后，

segments.text: slowly increase the polarity of the solvent to a mixture that puts the next spot at an RF of 0.3.
segments.zh: 再慢慢增大溶剂极性，换成使下一个斑点 Rf 值为 0.3 的混合溶剂。

segments.text: Continue this until all desired spots have come off of the column.
segments.zh: 如此继续，直到所有需要的斑点都从柱子上下来。

segments.text: Once you have picked an appropriate solvent system, you need to decide how much adsorbent to use.
segments.zh: 选好合适的溶剂体系后，你需要决定用多少吸附剂。

segments.text: This video will illustrate the use of a silica gel column,
segments.zh: 本视频将演示硅胶柱的使用，

segments.text: but the same procedure can be followed using alumina.
segments.zh: 但用氧化铝时也可以按照相同的步骤操作。

segments.text: Caution. Silica and alumina are highly toxic when inhaled. Handle adsorbents in the hood.
segments.zh: 注意！吸入硅胶和氧化铝毒性很大。请在通风橱中处理吸附剂。

segments.text: In cases with good separation, a 20 to 1 mass ratio of silica gel to compound is usually
segments.zh: 在分离效果好的情况下，硅胶与化合物的质量比为 20 比 1 通常

segments.text: adequate. This means that for 1 gram of compound, you would use 20 grams of silica.
segments.zh: 就足够了。也就是说，1 克化合物要用 20 克硅胶。

segments.text: It is good to use as little adsorbent as possible, but when the separation is more difficult,
segments.zh: 吸附剂用得越少越好，但当分离比较困难时，

segments.text: ratios of 50 or 100 to 1 may be necessary. Choosing the appropriate amount of adsorbent
segments.zh: 可能需要 50 比 1 或 100 比 1 的比例。选择合适的吸附剂用量

segments.text: takes practice. Until you have developed your own intuition, it is a good idea to ask a more
segments.zh: 需要练习。在你形成自己的直觉之前，最好向更有

segments.text: experienced chemist for advice. Weigh the silica into an Erlenmeyer flask in the hood.
segments.zh: 经验的化学工作者请教。在通风橱中把硅胶称入锥形瓶。

segments.text: Use a flask large enough that you don't fill it more than 1 third full.
segments.zh: 所用锥形瓶要足够大，使硅胶不超过其容积的三分之一。

segments.text: The last major decision to make is what diameter of column to use.
segments.zh: 最后一个重要的决定是用多粗的柱子。

segments.text: Different people have very different opinions about this, but in general, it is a good idea
segments.zh: 对此，不同的人看法差别很大，但一般来说，最好

segments.text: to choose a column that will fill 6 to 7 inches with the chosen amount of silica.
segments.zh: 选一根装入选定量的硅胶后高度为 6 到 7 英寸的柱子。

segments.text: In a taller column, the different bands of compounds will disperse and overlap,
segments.zh: 柱子太高，不同化合物的色带会扩散并相互重叠，

segments.text: but a shorter column will not have enough surface area to give good separation.
segments.zh: 而柱子太矮，又没有足够的表面积来实现良好的分离。

segments.text: Packing a column with adsorbent can be fairly tricky,
segments.zh: 用吸附剂装柱可能相当棘手，

segments.text: and it takes practice to be able to do it well every time.
segments.zh: 要每次都装得好需要练习。

segments.text: The first step involves plugging the bottom of the column with a small piece of cotton
segments.zh: 第一步是用一小团棉花塞住柱子底部，

segments.text: to prevent loss of silica gel. Roll a small piece of cotton between your fingers
segments.zh: 以防硅胶流失。用手指把一小块棉花搓圆，

segments.text: and drop it into the column. Tilt and tap the column until the cotton settles into
segments.zh: 然后丢进柱子里。倾斜并轻敲柱子，直到棉花落到

segments.text: the center depression. Using a long stick, gently pack the cotton into the hole. Don't
segments.zh: 中心的凹陷处。用一根长棒把棉花轻轻压进孔里。不要

segments.text: pack the cotton too tightly or it will be difficult to force solvent through the plug.
segments.zh: 把棉花压得太紧，否则溶剂很难通过这个棉塞。

segments.text: To continue packing the column, you will need an empty beaker,
segments.zh: 要继续装柱，你需要一个空烧杯、

segments.text: a pipette, a supply of your chosen solvent mixture,
segments.zh: 一支滴管、充足的选定混合溶剂、

segments.text: a funnel, your pre-weighed silica gel, some sand, and a flash pressure apparatus.
segments.zh: 一个漏斗、预先称好的硅胶、一些砂子，以及一套快速柱加压装置。

segments.text: With the cotton in place, clamp the column in a straight vertical position
segments.zh: 棉花放好后，把柱子垂直夹好，

segments.text: and use a funnel to pour in a small layer of sand, approximately 1 to 2 millimeters.
segments.zh: 用漏斗倒入一薄层砂子，约 1 到 2 毫米。

segments.text: Now, fill the column with approximately 5 inches of solvent mixture. Make sure that
segments.zh: 现在，往柱子里加入约 5 英寸高的混合溶剂。确保

segments.text: the sand layer is flat and no sand is stuck to the sides. Pour enough of the solvent mixture
segments.zh: 砂层平整，侧壁上没有粘砂子。往硅胶中倒入足够的混合溶剂，

segments.text: into the silica gel to form a mobile slurry. Swirl the silica and carefully pour it into
segments.zh: 形成可流动的浆液。旋摇硅胶，小心地把它倒入

segments.text: the column, making sure that you do not disturb the sand layer. Use additional solvent to add
segments.zh: 柱子，注意不要扰动砂层。用更多的溶剂把

segments.text: the remaining silica. Once you have added all of the silica, rinse the funnel and sides of the
segments.zh: 剩余的硅胶加进去。所有硅胶都加完后，用少量溶剂冲洗漏斗和

segments.text: column with a small amount of solvent. Apply pressure to the top of the column and open
segments.zh: 柱子侧壁。在柱子顶部加压，并打开

segments.text: the stopcock, tapping the sides of the column gently to make sure that the silica layer is flat.
segments.zh: 活塞，轻敲柱子侧壁，确保硅胶层平整。

segments.text: Drain the solvent until 2 or 3 inches remain above the silica layer.
segments.zh: 放出溶剂，直到硅胶层上方还剩 2 到 3 英寸。

segments.text: Then close the stopcock and remove the pressure.
segments.zh: 然后关闭活塞，撤去压力。

segments.text: Caution! Make sure there are no bubbles before you add sand.
segments.zh: 注意！在加砂子之前，确保没有气泡。

segments.text: Bubbles and inconsistencies in your column will cause serious problems later.
segments.zh: 柱子里的气泡和不均匀之处之后会造成严重的问题。

segments.text: To avoid bubbles, use a very wet slurry of silica gel, gently tap the sides of the
segments.zh: 为避免气泡，要使用很稀的硅胶浆液，在装填硅胶时轻敲

segments.text: column while packing the silica, and apply pressure before opening the stopcock.
segments.zh: 柱子侧壁，并在打开活塞之前先加压。

segments.text: When you have achieved a uniform layer of adsorbent, use a pipette to rinse any excess
segments.zh: 得到均匀的吸附剂层后，用滴管把柱子侧壁上多余的

segments.text: silica down from the sides of the column. Using the funnel, carefully add a small layer of sand.
segments.zh: 硅胶冲下去。用漏斗小心地加入一薄层砂子。

segments.text: Be careful not to disturb the top of the silica gel. Use a small amount of solvent
segments.zh: 注意不要扰动硅胶的顶部。用少量溶剂

segments.text: to wash the excess sand from the sides of the column. Apply pressure, open the stopcock,
segments.zh: 把柱子侧壁上多余的砂子冲下去。加压，打开活塞，

segments.text: and drain the solvent to just above the silica gel.
segments.zh: 把溶剂放到刚好高于硅胶的位置。

segments.text: Caution! Never let the solvent layer drop below the top of the column.
segments.zh: 注意！绝不要让溶剂液面降到柱子顶部以下。

segments.text: Now you're ready to load your sample onto the column. There are a couple of ways to do this.
segments.zh: 现在可以把样品上到柱子上了。有几种方法可以做到。

segments.text: If your sample is soluble in the chosen solvent system,
segments.zh: 如果你的样品可溶于所选的溶剂体系，

segments.text: then it is easiest to load your sample as a solution.
segments.zh: 那么最简单的方法是以溶液形式上样。

segments.text: Dissolve your sample in the smallest possible volume of the chosen solvent mixture.
segments.zh: 把样品溶解在尽可能少的选定混合溶剂中。

segments.text: If you have trouble getting it to dissolve, try adding a few drops of methylene chloride.
segments.zh: 如果难以溶解，可以试着加几滴二氯甲烷。

segments.text: It is vital that your sample is completely dissolved before you add it to the column.
segments.zh: 至关重要的是，样品在加到柱子上之前必须完全溶解。

segments.text: Slowly drip the solution of sample around the edges of the column,
segments.zh: 把样品溶液沿柱子边缘缓慢滴入，

segments.text: being careful not to disturb the sand layer. Lower the solvent level to just above the silica,
segments.zh: 注意不要扰动砂层。把溶剂液面降到刚好高于硅胶的位置，

segments.text: rinse the flask with a small amount of solvent, and add the rinse in the same fashion.
segments.zh: 用少量溶剂冲洗烧瓶，并以同样的方式加入冲洗液。

segments.text: Lower the solvent level again and repeat the rinse one or two times.
segments.zh: 再次降低溶剂液面，重复冲洗一到两次。

segments.text: It is a good idea to rinse any residual sample from the sides of the column,
segments.zh: 最好把柱子侧壁上残留的样品也冲下去，

segments.text: lowering the solvent level in between each rinse.
segments.zh: 每次冲洗之间都要降低溶剂液面。

segments.text: Now you're ready to fill the column with solvent.
segments.zh: 现在可以往柱子里加满溶剂了。

segments.text: Start by slowly adding solvent with a pipette. Once you have added a nice cushion, slowly pour the
segments.zh: 先用滴管慢慢加入溶剂。加好一层不错的缓冲液层后，再把

segments.text: remaining solvent into the column, being careful not to disturb the sand or the silica.
segments.zh: 剩余的溶剂慢慢倒入柱子，注意不要扰动砂子或硅胶。

segments.text: Done correctly, you should end up with a thin band of sample just below the sand.
segments.zh: 操作正确的话，你应该会在砂层下方得到一条很窄的样品带。

segments.text: When your sample is largely insoluble in the chosen solvent mixture, it is more effective
segments.zh: 当你的样品在所选混合溶剂中基本不溶时，更有效的做法是

segments.text: to pre-absorb the sample onto a small quantity of silica and add it as a dry mixture.
segments.zh: 先把样品预吸附在少量硅胶上，再以干的混合物形式加入。

segments.text: To do this, you will need some methylene chloride, a round bottom flask, and some silica gel.
segments.zh: 为此，你需要一些二氯甲烷、一个圆底烧瓶和一些硅胶。

segments.text: Start by dissolving your sample in methylene chloride and transferring it to the round
segments.zh: 先把样品溶解在二氯甲烷中，然后转移到圆底

segments.text: bottom flask. Make sure you complete the transfer with a few rinses,
segments.zh: 烧瓶里。一定要冲洗几次以完成转移，

segments.text: then add a small amount of silica gel to the flask and swirl to mix.
segments.zh: 然后往烧瓶中加入少量硅胶，旋摇混匀。

segments.text: Before you can remove the solvent on the rotavap, stuff a few kim wipes into the bump trap
segments.zh: 在旋转蒸发仪上除去溶剂之前，先往防暴沸球里塞几张 Kimwipes 擦拭纸，

segments.text: to prevent contamination of the rotavap with the very fine silica powder.
segments.zh: 以防非常细的硅胶粉末污染旋转蒸发仪。

segments.text: Attach your flask to the bump trap and concentrate it on the rotavap until you
segments.zh: 把烧瓶接到防暴沸球上，在旋转蒸发仪上浓缩，直到

segments.text: obtain a fine, free-flowing powder. If the mixture remains clumpy or sticky,
segments.zh: 得到细腻、可自由流动的粉末。如果混合物仍然结块或发黏，

segments.text: you may need to re-dissolve the sample and add more silica gel.
segments.zh: 你可能需要重新溶解样品并加入更多硅胶。

segments.text: Don't add it to your column until it is a free-flowing powder.
segments.zh: 在它变成可自由流动的粉末之前，不要把它加到柱子上。

segments.text: To dry-load your sample, pack the column as before but leave a small layer of solvent
segments.zh: 干法上样时，像之前一样装柱，但在砂层上方

segments.text: above the sand. Pour the pre-absorbed silica onto the top of the sand. Use a small amount
segments.zh: 留一薄层溶剂。把预吸附好的硅胶倒在砂层上。用少量

segments.text: of the solvent mixture to rinse the flask and wash the silica down from the sides of the column.
segments.zh: 混合溶剂冲洗烧瓶，并把柱子侧壁上的硅胶冲下去。

segments.text: Drain the solvent to the top of the silica and add a small layer of sand. Carefully fill the
segments.zh: 把溶剂放到硅胶顶部，再加入一薄层砂子。像之前一样小心地往

segments.text: column with solvent as before. One alternative to dry-loading is loading your sample as a solution
segments.zh: 柱子里加满溶剂。干法上样的一种替代办法是，把样品溶解在

segments.text: in a solvent that is more polar than the solvent system you're using for your column.
segments.zh: 比过柱所用溶剂体系极性更大的溶剂中，以溶液形式上样。

segments.text: You will end up with a thick band of compound and poor separation.
segments.zh: 这样你最终会得到一条很宽的化合物带，分离效果很差。

segments.text: Once your sample is loaded on the column, you must begin running it immediately,
segments.zh: 一旦样品上到柱子上，就必须立即开始过柱，

segments.text: and it's a good idea not to take any breaks until it's through.
segments.zh: 而且最好在跑完之前不要休息。

segments.text: Before you start, make sure you have an adequate supply of your chosen solvent mixture
segments.zh: 开始之前，确保你备有充足的选定混合溶剂

segments.text: and a nice big rack of test tubes. Begin running the column by placing a test
segments.zh: 和一大架试管。开始过柱时，在柱子底部放一支

segments.text: tube at the bottom of the column, applying pressure to the top, and opening the stopcock.
segments.zh: 试管，在顶部加压，并打开活塞。

segments.text: If the pressure is right, you should have a fairly rapid flow of solvent out of the bottom of the
segments.zh: 如果压力合适，溶剂应该会以相当快的速度从柱子

segments.text: column. You may have to adjust the pressure so that the flow rate isn't a slow drip or
segments.zh: 底部流出。你可能需要调节压力，使流速既不是慢慢地一滴一滴，

segments.text: an out-of-control stream, but something right in the middle. Don't forget to continually collect
segments.zh: 也不是失控的一股激流，而是恰好介于两者之间。别忘了持续用试管

segments.text: the eluent in test tubes. You have to pay attention so that the solvent doesn't overflow.
segments.zh: 收集洗脱液。你必须留意，别让溶剂溢出来。

segments.text: Caution. Pay close attention to the solvent level and refill frequently.
segments.zh: 注意！密切关注溶剂液面，并经常补加。

segments.text: Now your hard work is over and it's time to see if it paid off.
segments.zh: 现在你的辛苦工作结束了，该看看是否有回报了。

segments.text: When your compound is colored, it can be easy to find it in the fractions,
segments.zh: 如果你的化合物是有颜色的，就很容易在各馏分中找到它，

segments.text: but a more reliable method for monitoring your column is with TLC.
segments.zh: 但监测过柱更可靠的方法是用 TLC。

segments.text: You can easily spot five or six fractions per TLC plate. Make sure you rinse your spotter in
segments.zh: 每块 TLC 板上你可以轻松点五六个馏分。在点不同馏分之间，

segments.text: between fractions. Develop the plates with a solvent mixture that spreads the spots out
segments.zh: 一定要冲洗点样管。用能把斑点在板上分散开的

segments.text: on the plate. It does not have to be the same solvent system you use for the column.
segments.zh: 混合溶剂展开。它不必与过柱所用的溶剂体系相同。

segments.text: If it goes well, you will end up with a maximum of one compound per fraction,
segments.zh: 如果顺利的话，你最终每个馏分里最多只有一种化合物，

segments.text: with a few clean fractions in between the compounds you're trying to separate.
segments.zh: 而在你要分离的各化合物之间还会有几个干净的馏分。

segments.text: Unfortunately, it doesn't always work out so well.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，事情并不总是这么顺利。

segments.text: Overlapping fractions containing more than one compound are the sign of a failed separation.
segments.zh: 含有不止一种化合物的重叠馏分，就是分离失败的标志。

segments.text: So what went wrong? If all of the material elutes in just a few fractions,
segments.zh: 那么问题出在哪里？如果所有物料都在少数几个馏分中洗脱出来，

segments.text: then the column may have been too small or the developing solvent too polar. On the other hand,
segments.zh: 那可能是柱子太小，或者展开溶剂极性太大。另一方面，

segments.text: if the compounds are spread out over many fractions, then the column may have been too
segments.zh: 如果化合物分散在许多馏分中，那可能是柱子太

segments.text: tall or you used too much solvent to load your sample. Once the last compound has come off of
segments.zh: 高，或者你上样时用了太多溶剂。一旦最后一种化合物从

segments.text: the column and you have analyzed your TLC plates, it is time to combine the desired fractions.
segments.zh: 柱子上下来，并且你分析完 TLC 板，就该合并所需的馏分了。

segments.text: Combine all of the fractions containing the same pure compound in a round bottom flask.
segments.zh: 把含有同一种纯化合物的所有馏分合并到一个圆底烧瓶中。

segments.text: Fractions containing more than one compound should be set aside for further purification.
segments.zh: 含有不止一种化合物的馏分应留待进一步纯化。

segments.text: It is a good idea to rinse the test tubes two or three times with a little bit of clean solvent
segments.zh: 最好用少量洁净溶剂冲洗试管两到三次，

segments.text: and add those rinses to the flask as well. Don't fill the flask more than half full.
segments.zh: 并把这些冲洗液也加入烧瓶。烧瓶装液不要超过一半。

segments.text: Remember, you need to concentrate it on the rotavap.
segments.zh: 记住，你还需要在旋转蒸发仪上浓缩它。

segments.text: Removing solvent from your compound is the last step in a chromatographic purification.
segments.zh: 从化合物中除去溶剂是色谱纯化的最后一步。

segments.text: Never discard any fractions until you recover the desired material.
segments.zh: 在回收到目标物料之前，绝不要丢弃任何馏分。

segments.text: It is a good idea to clean up the silica before you discard it in the appropriate waste container.
segments.zh: 最好先把硅胶清理干净，再把它丢进合适的废物容器。

segments.text: When you are sure that there is no more desired material on the column,
segments.zh: 当你确定柱子上已经没有目标物料时，

segments.text: fill the column with ethanol, place a flask underneath,
segments.zh: 往柱子里加满乙醇，下面放一个烧瓶，

segments.text: and push air through the column until the silica is dry and free flowing.
segments.zh: 然后向柱子中压入空气，直到硅胶干燥并能自由流动。

segments.text: At this point, it will be easy to discard the silica by pouring it into the proper waste container.
segments.zh: 这时，就很容易把硅胶倒进合适的废物容器丢弃了。

segments.text: When you need to purify a small amount of compound,
segments.zh: 当你需要纯化少量化合物时，

segments.text: it is sometimes easier to run a micro column in a pipette.
segments.zh: 有时在滴管中跑一根微型柱会更容易。

segments.text: On small scale, the packing and sample loading steps are greatly simplified.
segments.zh: 在小规模下，装柱和上样步骤都大大简化了。

segments.text: It is easiest to pack a micro column completely dry without any solvent.
segments.zh: 微型柱最容易的装法是完全干装，不用任何溶剂。

segments.text: Plug the end of the pipette with a small piece of cotton.
segments.zh: 用一小块棉花塞住滴管的末端。

segments.text: Then, add a couple of inches of adsorbent and a thin layer of sand.
segments.zh: 然后加入几英寸高的吸附剂和一薄层砂子。

segments.text: Next, add your sample, pre-absorbed onto a small amount of adsorbent.
segments.zh: 接着加入预吸附在少量吸附剂上的样品。

segments.text: Top it off with a thin layer of sand and you are ready to go.
segments.zh: 最上面再加一薄层砂子，就可以开始了。

segments.text: To run the column, place a collection flask or a test tube underneath the pipette,
segments.zh: 过柱时，在滴管下面放一个收集烧瓶或一支试管，

segments.text: and use another pipette to add solvent to the top of the column.
segments.zh: 用另一支滴管往柱子顶部加溶剂。

segments.text: Keep adding solvent until your compound has come off of the column.
segments.zh: 持续加入溶剂，直到你的化合物从柱子上下来。

segments.text: Make sure you don't let the column run dry.
segments.zh: 一定不要让柱子流干。

segments.text: This video has outlined the basic steps that you will use to perform a purification
segments.zh: 本视频概述了用柱色谱进行纯化的

segments.text: using column chromatography. Now it's time to get in the lab and try it for yourself.
segments.zh: 基本步骤。现在该进实验室亲自试一试了。

segments.text: Remember, this video is intended to help you prepare for lab
segments.zh: 记住，本视频旨在通过演示正确的实验技术，

segments.text: by providing a demonstration of the proper experimental technique.
segments.zh: 帮助你为实验做好准备。

segments.text: It is not intended as a replacement for reading your lab manual or the supplementary material.
segments.zh: 它并不能代替阅读你的实验手册或补充材料。

segments.text: In order to become a great experimentalist,
segments.zh: 要成为一名优秀的实验工作者，

segments.text: it is important that you understand both theory and technique.
segments.zh: 重要的是既要理解理论，也要掌握技术。

segments.text: Now it's your turn. Good luck!
segments.zh: 现在轮到你了。祝你好运！
